limitations: The 38 unique browser scenarios are a union of bounded runs; five were repeated after the last upstream advance.
Native Windows/Android launches, portable/native packaging, full GIS/C++ suites and deployment were not run.
OCR tests cover delayed-response cancellation and state isolation, not recognition accuracy.
Remote CI status is recorded in the PR separately.

Inactive editor and null viewer ports preserve ordinary map overlay and object hit blocking.
Middle-button and Space navigation preserve existing map policy; project replacement blocks input first.
